column3: The Hebrew leaves the object of rejecting unstated; BSB supplies us.
The Hebrew presents dwelling on Zion as completed; BSB uses dwell.
The Hebrew directly commands lifting the steps; BSB says turn them.
The Hebrew says they set their signs as signs; BSB supplies unfurling banners.
The Hebrew explicitly has a verb of being known and a singular one raising axes; BSB compares plural men wielding axes.
The Hebrew explicitly says now and together.
The Hebrew attaches to the ground to the defiling clause; BSB attaches it to burning.
The Hebrew does not explicitly supply us as those God met.
The Hebrew says we have not seen our signs; BSB says there are no signs to see.
The Hebrew leaves the first taunt’s object unnamed; BSB supplies You.
The Hebrew names hand and right hand separately and explicitly mentions His bosom; BSB says strong right hand and omits bosom.
The Hebrew has salvations in the plural and the midst of the earth.
The Hebrew says upon the waters rather than dragons of the sea.
The Hebrew names a people of the desert; BSB says creatures of the desert.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says luminary rather than explicitly moon.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew does not explicitly supply You as the first mocked object.
The Hebrew names the afflicted community rather than their lives.
The Hebrew has no possessive Your before covenant.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew names Your reproach from a fool; BSB turns this into how the fool mocks You.
The Hebrew says do not forget; BSB says do not disregard.
